finding: - any_of: {type: a, path_pattern: x} is valid YAML, and the engine accepts it. index-lint reads it as a string and reports "must be a non-empty list of alternatives". Source: brownfield onboarding run(../reviews/brownfield-onboarding-run-2026-10-16.md), review of ST-0313. Fix: Parse the flow form, or name the block form in the error.
why_this_severity: `index-lint` reads the valid line `- any_of: [...]` as a string and reports `must be a non-empty list of alternatives`, which sends the author to the wrong cause. The block form works, so an author can still declare alternatives (no to fails_purpose).
